programme: P27–P35 Local 54-Indicator Completion and Provenance Programme

relationship_to_prior_programmes.p18_p26: Existing governed data-completion programme remains the authority for its historical denominator and closure semantics.
relationship_to_prior_programmes.successor_rule: P27–P35 is a successor programme and must not rewrite P18–P26 completion counts or phase semantics.

objective: Ensure the same governed 54-indicator framework is explicitly represented for every constituency and ward, add county-level elected-representative data, permit rigorously labelled credible secondary evidence, and publish the most probable value when credible sources conflict while preserving the conflict record.

target_surface.rule: Every cell must have an explicit governed disposition. Numeric completeness is reported separately from disposition completeness.

non_negotiable_rules: Never copy a county value to a constituency or ward merely to fill a gap.
Never copy a constituency value to a ward merely to fill a gap.
Never use arbitrary equal splits or parent-rate downscaling.
Never treat repeated copies of one upstream source as independent corroboration.
Never average conflicting values solely to make them reconcile.
Never label secondary evidence as official.
Do not close a value as unavailable only because an official website or API is temporarily inaccessible or dynamically rendered.
Retain source, period, unit, geography/boundary vintage, retrieval/verification date, methodology and uncertainty metadata where applicable.
All generated ledgers and registries must rebuild deterministically from governed inputs and source/evidence snapshots where rights permit.
All 54 indicators remain visible in the UI at applicable geography levels even when the governed disposition is unavailable or not applicable.

secondary_fallback_trigger: primary source is unavailable, non-responsive, temporarily inaccessible or not machine-capturable after documented attempts
primary source is highly dynamic and a stable value can be independently verified from credible secondary evidence
primary source does not publish the required geography/period but credible secondary evidence documents the value and definition
multiple credible independent secondary sources materially agree and their evidence lineage can be distinguished

conflict_policy.principle: Preserve every defensible candidate observation, select one preferred observation only when a most-probable value can be justified, and disclose the conflict.
rules: Weights are methodology defaults and may be overridden only by an indicator-specific documented rule.
A newer value does not automatically outrank an older value if they refer to different observation periods or definitions.
Exact ward or constituency geography outranks an unmatched proxy geography.
Source copies with the same evidence lineage count once for corroboration.
Close-scoring, definition-incompatible or materially divergent candidates require manual review.
A public S4 preferred value must carry conflict=true, confidence, competing-value count and a human-readable selection note.

phases.title: Freeze the 54-indicator local contract
phases.goal: Reconcile the existing governed local indicator surface with the requested exact set of 54 and make applicability, definitions and permitted acquisition/derivation methods explicit.
acceptance: all 54 define permitted and prohibited derivations
all 54 define freshness and uncertainty/ranking constraints where relevant
historical P18–P26 counts are not rewritten

phases.title: Secondary-source and provenance governance
phases.goal: Make credible secondary evidence a governed fallback rather than an informal exception while preserving official-source priority and transparent labelling.
acceptance: secondary evidence cannot publish without label and fallback reason
official-source inaccessibility can trigger fallback but cannot itself create a value

phases.title: Build the complete 54 × local-geography denominator
phases.goal: Compile the deterministic successor ledger for all constituencies and wards and audit county coverage against the same 54-indicator framework.
acceptance: disposition and numeric completeness are reported separately

phases.title: County representation layer
phases.goal: Add a governed county-level elected-representative record and an extensible representation schema consistent with MP and MCA records.
acceptance: 47/47 counties have an explicit current Woman Representative disposition
role/person/party where verifiable/term/status/source tier/verification date are retained
MP and MCA can use the same schema without conflating roles
vacancy/by-election/disputed states do not silently carry stale officeholders

phases.title: Complete all 54 indicators across 290 constituencies
phases.goal: Resolve the constituency surface through reusable indicator-wide national pipelines and governed fallback, not manual constituency files.
acceptance: every defensibly obtainable constituency value is materialised
secondary/probable values carry labels and provenance

phases.title: Complete all 54 indicators across 1,450 wards
phases.goal: Resolve the ward surface using direct local evidence, exact aggregation, permitted geospatial derivation and governed secondary/modelled fallbacks.
acceptance: every defensibly obtainable ward value is materialised
secondary/probable values carry labels and provenance

phases.title: Candidate-value conflict resolution and probable-value publication
phases.goal: Operationalise a candidate-observation ledger and deterministic/manual-review process for conflicting credible values.
acceptance: zero preferred S4 values lack competing-source records
zero conflicts are resolved by unlabelled averaging
duplicate lineages do not inflate corroboration
every probable value has confidence and rationale
material close calls remain in review until adjudicated

phases.title: Expose all 54 indicators and representation in the public product
phases.goal: Make the full 54-indicator skeleton visible for each county, constituency and ward with provenance, freshness, confidence and conflict semantics.
acceptance: every constituency and ward renders the governed 54-indicator framework
secondary evidence is visually distinct from official evidence

phases.title: Permanent local-completeness, freshness and supersession gate
phases.goal: Convert the 54-indicator local surface into a release-blocking, continuously refreshable contract.
acceptance: dynamic observations carry as_of/verified_at and recheck rules
secondary observations are queued for primary confirmation/supersession

parallelism_note: P30 may run in parallel with early P31 acquisition after P28/P29 contracts are stable. Candidate ingestion for P33 may start during P31/P32, but P33 cannot close until both local levels are complete. Parallel execution cannot waive acceptance gates.
